messages:
Maria: Morning — quick async standup
Maria: Yesterday: landed the slot allocator tweak in the kernel, ran microbatch sims, saw ~6% p95 improvement for short sequences.
Lee: Nice. Any regression signals on p99?
Maria: p99 mostly steady, except one outlier on an 8k request that blows up memory churn. Dumped heap traces to /tmp/slot-sample.log and attached to issue.
Oliver: Blockers?
Maria: KV cold-starts still cause short latency spikes during warmup. Filed issue #1287 and added a failing case to the perf harness.
Sana: I pushed a small tweak to eviction heuristics (PR #4321) — canarying on dedicated-qa now. @Maria can you validate with your workload?
Maria: Will run the perf harness this afternoon. Command I use:
```
python infra/bench/run.py --suite=kv_warmup --iters=50 --target=dedicated-qa --capture-traces
```
Lee: Quick FYI: batching heuristic change (slot packing) needs a one-line doc update in runtime/README so oncall knows the flag.
Oliver: I'll review PR #4321 later today. If looks good, we can promote to canary in prod-2 during the 4–6pm window.
Sana: Added metric `kv.warmup.latency.p95` to the runtime dashboard and a short alert at 2x baseline.
eng-bot: Canary deployment started for `sana/evict-tune` on dedicated-qa (build 2026-03-18_14:10).
Maria: Today: run harness baseline + patched, triage p99 traces, follow up with Sana on extra logs. If numbers look good, schedule promote.
Lee: I'll pick up the README doc patch and update the rollout playbook.
Oliver: I'll queue the CR approvals and the canary checklist.
Maria: Tiny ask — when you run the harness please add `--capture-traces` and attach the zip to the issue so I can diff callstacks.
Sana: Ack — running baseline then patched now, will post numbers and the traces:thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks. Ping me when finished and I'll run the combined comparison script (tools/perf/compare_kv_reports.py).
Sana: will do — standing by.
